units.source_text: 次日早上醒来，夕雾不知不觉地感到羞耻。

en.t: When he woke the next morning, Yugiri found himself feeling ashamed without quite knowing why.

units.source_text: 他回到自己房间里，写一封信给云居雁。

en.t: He returned to his own room and wrote a letter to Kumoinokari.

units.source_text: 但小侍从也找不到，云居雁房中当然不能去，胸中烦闷不堪。

en.t: But he could not find the young attendant either, and of course he could not go to Kumoinokari's room, so his heart was unbearably troubled.

units.source_text: 云居雁呢，只觉得被父亲责怪是可耻的。

en.t: As for Kumoinokari, she only felt ashamed that her father had scolded her.

units.source_text: 至于自身将来如何，别人对她作何看法等事，一概不加深思。

en.t: She gave no deep thought at all to what would become of her in the future, or how others might judge her.
She remained innocent and lovable as ever.

units.source_text: 别人议论他们两人之事，她听了既不觉得异常讨厌，也不想与夕雾分离。

en.t: When she heard people gossiping about the two of them, she neither found it especially hateful nor wished to be separated from Yugiri.

units.source_text: 她认为不必如此大惊小怪。

en.t: She thought there was no need to make such a great fuss.

units.source_text: 只可惜服侍她的乳母和侍女们严厉劝戒她，今后不便再和夕雾通信了。

en.t: Unfortunately, the nurse and waiting women who served her sternly admonished her, so from then on it was no longer easy for her to exchange letters with Yugiri.

units.source_text: 倘是大人，际此困境自能巧妙找寻机会。

en.t: Had he been an adult, he would naturally have found some clever chance even in such a difficult situation.

units.source_text: 但夕雾年幼，毫无办法，只是闷闷不乐而已。

en.t: But Yugiri was still young and had no way to act, so he could only sit in gloomy unhappiness.
